t: Penetrates to release seized fixings and stuck or rusted parts. Lubricates moving mechanical parts. Displaces moisture from damp electrical equipment.
b: Releases Corroded Nuts, Bolts, Valves & Locks
Dries Electrical Systems Eliminating Moisture-Induced Short Circuits
Use on Engines, Spark Plugs & Power Tools
Safe on Metal, Plastics, Glass Rubber & Wood
Shields Against Moisture & Other Corrosive Elements
